label: Summary, not the full plan text
status: DESCRIPTIVE; no interval or luck inference
private_pin: The lock commit is in a private repository without a public immutable ref. It identifies our saved plan; it is not public timestamp proof.
amendments: Amendment 1: the interval method failed calibration in 3 of 5 synthetic scenarios; the study became descriptive before market results.
Amendment 2: after the first run refused before a trade, one impossible minute was treated as missing, counted and never repaired; a second lock preceded the completed run.
scope: These two index funds, SPY and QQQ; this entry (ours); these costs; 2004-2026 with no QQQ trades from late July 2004 to mid-December 2011. EARLY is mostly SPY. Iliya, on indices: 'But on indices, I use a bit more of a VWAP' (471.12-479.919s).
money: R PER TRADE = RESULT / PLANNED RISK PER SHARE, fixed before entry; not account equity or a loss cap. Estimated primary round trip $0.04/share, plus assumed short borrow 3% annual /252 for one day; commission zero. Costs and borrow availability are assumptions, not observed fills. Lower gap = kept worse order minus removed better order; upper gap = kept better order minus removed worse order.
mechanics:
[MEASURED: our specification] The entry is OUR reading of Iliya's lower-frame rule. Iliya says: "How does the break work? We need the body closure above or below the MA. That is our confirmation." . We read that as a 15-minute close crossing the 15-minute 50 EMA. A long needs the previous close at or below the previous EMA and the current close above the current EMA; a short is the mirror . The rest of the trade is also ours, not Iliya's :
- Fill: the next minute's open.
- Stop: one cent beyond the signal candle's extreme.
- Target: two times the planned risk.
- Time exit: at 120 minutes, or at the last minute's open.
- Unit: R = result divided by the planned risk per share, fixed before entry.

[MEASURED: our cost estimates] Round trip, per share: $0.02, $0.04 (primary) or $0.10. Shorts also pay an assumed 3% annual borrow for one day. Commission is 0 . These are estimates, not broker quotes.

[MEASURED: comparison design] The entries are the same in both groups, with identical exits and costs.
- KEPT: at the decision, the completed 1-hour and 4-hour 50 EMAs both point the trade's way: close on the trade's side of the EMA, and slope the trade's way .
- REMOVED: every other entry, split into against / mixed / flat .

The slope rule is a numeric one we chose . Iliya says: "There is no good slope. You just need to see it visually trending higher or lower." .
support: Retrospective complete regular sessions with 250 prior valid bars per frame. This is retrospective selection, not a real-time tradable support screen; no inference to excluded sessions.
comparison: Same entries, exits and cost rules; completed hourly and four-hour 50 EMA directions both match the trade for kept, every other entry removed.
source_limit: Iliya reads slope visually; our flat band is a numeric choice. The source describes a confluence inside a full system. No claim about skill, accounts, courses, future results or other markets.

ledger_columns.design: D00, the primary registered mechanics; other design ledgers are not in this file.

ledger_columns.decision: Completed signal-bar end, in minute offsets from the session open.
ledger_columns.entry: Observed entry minute, in minute offsets from the session open.
ledger_columns.deadline: Reserved time-exit minute offset; may be later than the actual exit.
ledger_columns.exit_minute: Actual simulated exit minute offset from the session open.
ledger_columns.order: Signal-close reference rounded to cents, in integer millionths of a dollar per share.
ledger_columns.stop: Planned stop price, in integer millionths of a dollar per share.
ledger_columns.target: Planned target price, in integer millionths of a dollar per share.
ledger_columns.risk: Planned risk per share fixed before entry, in integer millionths of a dollar. Not account capital or a loss cap.
ledger_columns.fill: Observed entry-open price, in integer millionths of a dollar per share.
ledger_columns.adverse_exit: Exit price for the adverse ordering of touches, in integer millionths of a dollar per share.
ledger_columns.favorable_exit: Exit price for the favorable ordering of touches, in integer millionths of a dollar per share.
ledger_columns.reason: Saved exit reason: entry_gap, time, stop_gap, target_gap, ambiguous, stop or target. Ambiguous means both stop and target touched in the same observed minute.
ledger_columns.state: Hourly/four-hour pair state: up, down, mixed, flat or unknown.
ledger_columns.h_dir: Hourly direction code: 1 up, -1 down, 0 flat, 2 mixed price/slope, 9 unknown.
ledger_columns.f_dir: Four-hour direction code: 1 up, -1 down, 0 flat, 2 mixed price/slope, 9 unknown.
ledger_columns.kept: True only when both completed hourly and four-hour 50 EMA directions match side; otherwise False (removed).
ledger_columns.daily: Prior completed daily direction: 1 up, -1 down, 0 flat, 2 mixed price/slope, 9 unknown.
ledger_columns.q4_eligible: Saved daily-frame support flag for the separate three-frame question; does not select this primary file.
ledger_columns.q4_kept: Saved daily-plus-hourly-plus-four-hour agreement flag; does not select this primary file.

ledger_columns.gross_upper_num: Favorable-order gross numerator. Divide by denominator for gross R per trade; planned risk, not account return.

ledger_columns.net_upper_num_0.02: Favorable-order net numerator at estimated $0.02 round trip per share plus assumed short borrow. Divide by denominator for net R per trade.
